title: Many More Metals And Gems
description: This mod adds 4 new metals: Vibranium,Steel,Skysteel,Aetherite. And 3 new gems: Painite,Prismara,Kyawthuite. This mod adds one new structure/dungeon with valueable loot.This mod also adds one type of new weapon:Dagger.
body:
This is my first mod.This mod adds some custom gems and metals you can craft equipment and tools with.This mod adds 2 types of new tools:Dagger,Chisel.This mod adds 1 structure/dungeon with valueable loot.When you break a gem ore the block drops geode which is useless.When diamond/netherite chisel is placed near a geode you get a crystal which you can craft with.With Kyawthuite Geode the craft is more difficult than other geodes.
Made with MCreator.
